name: spec-review
description: For a planner before its plan is approved, and for a replay of an archived spec: the spec-review skill, which has two fresh, read-only reader agents read a task's spec.md and tickets in parallel, one as a stranger who paraphrases them and one as the builder who checks each ticket against the code, and writes their findings to spec-review.md for the spec's author to sort. No MCP server, hook or script.
